Fist Glenvora is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.
“
These writers sure do have a lot to say. The amount of trees they must have cut down to print all these papers... And people complain about the Steel Watch taking up resources.
„
— Glenvora

Involvement

Act Three

Glenvora is watching over several employees of the Baldur's Mouth, accompanied by  Fist Jerbold and a  Steel Watcher. They can be found near the entrance to the building at X: -12 Y: -51, guarding  Trina,  Zita,  Falael,  Bronte,  Delcan and  Jarlath, who are counting, packing and loading freshly printed issues of Baldur's Mouth Gazette.

Unlike Jerbold, Glenvora harbors no illusions on the newspaper contents, plainly claiming that the Gazette only prints "lies and drivel".

After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Glenvora tries to put up a good front, saying that the inactive Watcher is "experiencing a temporary reset".
